gold_reference_reply: Avoid using superglue or safety pins as that can permanently ruin the contact pins. Bring your device to an Apple Store where technicians have specialized non-conductive tools to extract the plug.

customer_tweet: Does Apple offer loaner phones while my iPhone is being repaired?
true_escalation_reason: Loaner phone policy (subject to store inventory and repair type).
gold_reference_reply: Apple Stores may offer loaner devices for qualifying repairs that require off-site depot repair, subject to store inventory and availability. Ask the Genius Bar technician during check-in.

customer_tweet: A mysterious yellow tint appeared on the bottom left corner of my iPad screen.
true_escalation_reason: LCD backlight diffuser glue curing defect or pressure mark.
gold_reference_reply: A localized yellow stain typically indicates an adhesive cure issue or pressure damage on the backlight diffuser. Please DM us so we can inspect photos and check warranty repair options.

customer_tweet: Is water resistance on iPhone 8 covered under the 1-year limited warranty if water gets in?
true_escalation_reason: Warranty exclusion policy: liquid damage is not covered by the 1-year limited warranty.
gold_reference_reply: While iPhone 8 has IP67 water and dust resistance, resistance can decrease with normal wear, and liquid damage is not covered under the Apple 1-Year Limited Warranty.

customer_tweet: My Apple Watch screen popped completely off the watch body while I was sleeping!
true_escalation_reason: Swollen battery pushing watch display off; covered under Apple extended service coverage.
gold_reference_reply: This is often caused by an expanding battery. Apple has an extended service policy for this condition on certain Apple Watch models. Do not press it back on. Please DM us your serial number immediately.

customer_tweet: How do I get rid of the padlock icon with a circle arrow around it at the top right of my screen?
true_escalation_reason: Standard Portrait Orientation Lock feature explanation.
gold_reference_reply: That icon is the Portrait Orientation Lock! Swipe up from the bottom of your screen (or down from top right on iPhone X) to open Control Center, and tap the padlock icon to unlock screen rotation.

customer_tweet: How do I delete apps in iOS 11? When I press and hold an app, nothing wiggles anymore.
true_escalation_reason: 3D Touch vs long press distinction in iOS.
gold_reference_reply: On devices with 3D Touch, rest your finger lightly on the app icon without pressing hard. After about 2 seconds, the apps will start jiggling and show the 'X' to delete!

customer_tweet: Where did the Auto-Brightness setting go in iOS 11? It used to be under Display & Brightness.
true_escalation_reason: UI location change: moved to Accessibility.
gold_reference_reply: In iOS 11, Auto-Brightness was moved to Accessibility! You can find it at Settings > General > Accessibility > Display Accommodations > Auto-Brightness.

customer_tweet: How do I set up Face ID on my new iPhone X?
true_escalation_reason: Standard setup walkthrough for Face ID.
gold_reference_reply: Congrats on the iPhone X! Go to Settings > Face ID & Passcode, tap Set Up Face ID, position your face in the circle, and gently roll your head to complete the scan.

customer_tweet: How do I record my iPhone screen with audio in iOS 11?
true_escalation_reason: Screen recording Control Center setup and microphone toggle.
gold_reference_reply: Add Screen Recording in Settings > Control Center > Customize Controls. Open Control Center, 3D Touch the record circle, tap Microphone Audio to turn on mic sound, and tap Start Recording!

customer_tweet: Can I trade in my iPhone 6s towards the purchase of an iPhone 8?
true_escalation_reason: Apple GiveBack / Trade-In program explanation.
gold_reference_reply: Yes, absolutely! Through the Apple Trade In program, you can trade in your iPhone 6s for instant credit towards an iPhone 8 or an Apple Gift Card. Check estimated values at apple.com/shop/trade-in.

customer_tweet: How do I turn on True Tone display on my iPad Pro?
true_escalation_reason: True Tone toggle in Display & Brightness.
gold_reference_reply: You can turn on True Tone in Settings > Display & Brightness > True Tone, or by swiping open Control Center, hard pressing the brightness slider, and tapping the True Tone icon.

customer_tweet: How do I force close an app on iPhone X without a home button?
true_escalation_reason: iPhone X gesture navigation explanation.
gold_reference_reply: On iPhone X, swipe up from the bottom edge and pause your finger in the middle of the screen to open the app switcher. Touch and hold any app card until red '-' circles appear, then swipe up to close.

customer_tweet: What does the blue crescent moon icon in the status bar mean?
true_escalation_reason: Do Not Disturb indicator explanation.
gold_reference_reply: The crescent moon icon means Do Not Disturb is currently turned on, which silences incoming calls and notifications. You can toggle it off in Control Center or Settings > Do Not Disturb.

customer_tweet: How do I move my data from an Android phone to my new iPhone?
true_escalation_reason: Move to iOS app walkthrough.
gold_reference_reply: Download the Move to iOS app on your Android phone from the Google Play Store. When setting up your new iPhone, choose Move Data from Android on the Apps & Data screen to transfer contacts, photos, and messages!

customer_tweet: Can I use Siri without holding the home button or speaking loudly?
true_escalation_reason: Type to Siri accessibility feature setup.
gold_reference_reply: Yes! iOS 11 includes Type to Siri. You can enable it in Settings > General > Accessibility > Siri > Type to Siri. Now invoking Siri brings up a keyboard for silent typing.

customer_tweet: How do I take a screenshot on the iPhone X without a home button?
true_escalation_reason: iPhone X screenshot button combination.
gold_reference_reply: To take a screenshot on iPhone X, press and quickly release the Side button and the Volume Up button at the exact same time. A thumbnail preview will appear in the lower-left corner!

customer_tweet: What is the difference between iCloud Drive and iCloud Backup?
true_escalation_reason: Conceptual clarification between document sync vs whole device backup.
gold_reference_reply: iCloud Drive stores and syncs your individual documents, files, and app folders across devices. iCloud Backup saves your entire device state (settings, app data, messages) so you can restore a new device.

customer_tweet: How do I set up Apple Pay on my Apple Watch?
true_escalation_reason: Watch app Wallet setup workflow.
gold_reference_reply: Open the Apple Watch app on your iPhone, go to the My Watch tab, tap Wallet & Apple Pay, and tap Add Card to register your payment card to your watch.

customer_tweet: How do I silence unknown callers on iOS?
true_escalation_reason: Do Not Disturb contact whitelist workaround / feature guide.
gold_reference_reply: You can configure Do Not Disturb in Settings > Do Not Disturb > Allow Calls From > All Contacts. This silences calls from numbers not saved in your Contacts list while allowing known friends to ring.

customer_tweet: Is it possible to customize the toggles in Control Center on iOS 11?
true_escalation_reason: Control Center customization settings guide.
gold_reference_reply: Yes, iOS 11 lets you customize Control Center! Head over to Settings > Control Center > Customize Controls, where you can add, remove, and reorder shortcuts like Low Power Mode and Timer.

customer_tweet: How do I change the default search engine in Safari from Google to DuckDuckGo?
true_escalation_reason: Safari settings search engine configuration.
gold_reference_reply: That is easy to change! Go to Settings > Safari > Search Engine, and select DuckDuckGo from the list.

customer_tweet: Can I use Apple Pencil with my iPhone 8 Plus?
true_escalation_reason: Hardware compatibility clarification: Apple Pencil is only compatible with iPad models.
gold_reference_reply: Apple Pencil is designed specifically for compatible iPad models (iPad Pro and 6th generation iPad) and does not work with any iPhone models.

customer_tweet: How do I scan documents directly in the Notes app on iOS 11?
true_escalation_reason: Notes document scanner feature tutorial.
gold_reference_reply: Open Notes, create or open a note, tap the '+' icon above the keyboard, tap Scan Documents, and point the camera at your document. Notes will automatically capture and crop it!

customer_tweet: What does Offload Unused Apps mean in iPhone Storage settings?
true_escalation_reason: Offload Apps storage optimization explanation.
gold_reference_reply: Offloading frees up the storage space used by the app itself while keeping all its documents and data safe. When you reinstall the app from the App Store, all your data is instantly restored.

customer_tweet: How do I set up Emergency SOS so it calls my emergency contacts automatically?
true_escalation_reason: Emergency SOS and Medical ID setup in Health app.
gold_reference_reply: Go to Settings > Emergency SOS to configure Auto Call. To add emergency contacts who receive your location text, open the Health app, tap Medical ID, and add your trusted emergency contacts.

customer_tweet: Can I use Night Shift and Low Power Mode at the same time?
true_escalation_reason: Feature compatibility clarification.
gold_reference_reply: Yes! In newer iOS versions, you can enable both Low Power Mode and Night Shift simultaneously through Control Center or Settings > Display & Brightness.

customer_tweet: How do I invert screen colors for high contrast on iOS 11?
true_escalation_reason: Smart Invert vs Classic Invert accessibility setup.
gold_reference_reply: iOS 11 features Smart Invert! Go to Settings > General > Accessibility > Display Accommodations > Invert Colors, and select Smart Invert which reverses colors without altering photos or media.

customer_tweet: How do I turn off read receipts for iMessage so people don't know when I read their text?
true_escalation_reason: iMessage read receipts toggle.
gold_reference_reply: Go to Settings > Messages and toggle off Send Read Receipts. You can also toggle this individually per conversation by tapping the 'i' info icon at the top of a text thread.

customer_tweet: Can two people share the same health data on the Health app?
true_escalation_reason: Health data privacy architecture explanation.
gold_reference_reply: Health data is end-to-end encrypted and tied directly to each individual Apple ID for strict privacy. You can export health records as XML from your profile, but live syncing across IDs is not supported.

customer_tweet: How do I turn on the Magnifier feature using the triple-click shortcut?
true_escalation_reason: Accessibility shortcut configuration.
gold_reference_reply: Turn on Magnifier in Settings > General > Accessibility > Magnifier. Then scroll down to Accessibility Shortcut and check Magnifier so a triple-click of the side or Home button opens it instantly!

customer_tweet: Why does my phone say 'Press home to open' instead of 'Slide to unlock'?
true_escalation_reason: iOS lockscreen design change explanation and Rest Finger to Open setting.
gold_reference_reply: Apple updated the lockscreen mechanics in iOS 10. If you prefer opening without clicking the button, turn on Rest Finger to Open in Settings > General > Accessibility > Home Button.

customer_tweet: How do I silence Siri so she only responds with voice when my ringer switch is on?
true_escalation_reason: Siri Voice Feedback settings adjustment.
gold_reference_reply: You can change this in Settings > Siri & Search > Voice Feedback. Select Control With Ring Switch so Siri stays silent whenever your physical ring switch is set to silent.
